name: Phos Labs
description: Commerce intelligence for AI agents. Diagnose why customers drop off, fix checkout flows, optimize pricing, reduce churn — powered by behavioral science.

skills.name: Diagnose Customer Drop-off
skills.description: Find where and why customers abandon your funnel. Analyzes each step for statistically significant drop-offs and identifies the behavioral barrier at each point.
examples: Why are customers abandoning at checkout?
Diagnose our signup funnel drop-off
Where in our onboarding flow do users quit?

skills.name: Fix Checkout Flow
skills.description: Redesign a checkout, signup, or purchase flow to reduce abandonment. Returns a step-by-step redesigned flow with behavioral principles applied.
examples: Redesign our checkout to reduce cart abandonment
Fix our signup flow — too many people drop off at step 3
Optimize our payment page for conversion

skills.name: Write Converting Product Copy
skills.description: Write product descriptions, landing page copy, or marketing messages that convert — using social proof, loss framing, anchoring, and scarcity signals.
examples: Write a product description for our SaaS tool that increases trial signups
Rewrite this landing page to convert better
Write persuasive copy for our pricing page

skills.name: Optimize Pricing Strategy
skills.description: Design price framing, anchoring, and tier structure to maximize willingness to pay. Includes decoy pricing analysis and value articulation.
examples: How should we structure our pricing tiers?
Optimize our pricing page for higher ARPU
Design a pricing strategy with decoy options

skills.name: Predict Customer Churn
skills.description: Identify which customers are about to leave and why. Returns churn risk scores with behavioral drivers and retention interventions.
examples: Which users are most likely to cancel?
Predict churn risk for our subscriber base
Why are customers leaving after month 3?

skills.name: Personalize Sales Approach
skills.description: Segment customers by decision-making style and recommend tailored approaches for each segment. Returns behavioral personas with intervention strategies.
examples: How should we personalize our onboarding for different user types?
Segment our customers by how they make purchase decisions
What decision-making styles do our users have?

skills.name: Add Social Proof Signals
skills.description: Design social proof elements — what others bought, reviews, peer behavior signals. Analyzes descriptive vs injunctive norms for maximum impact.
examples: What social proof should we add to our product pages?
Design social proof for our checkout flow
How do we use peer behavior to increase signups?

skills.name: Design A/B Experiment
skills.description: Design a rigorous A/B test with sample size calculations, metrics, treatment arms, and statistical power analysis.
examples: Design an A/B test for our new checkout flow
How many users do we need for a valid experiment?
Set up an experiment to test our pricing change

skills.name: Ethics & Dark Pattern Audit
skills.description: Audit a design, intervention, or recommendation for dark patterns, manipulation, and autonomy violations. Returns ethics score with specific fixes.
examples: Is our urgency messaging manipulative?
Audit our checkout for dark patterns
Check if our nudges are ethical
